about:
Pacifica Foods Company, based in Vernon, California, has operated as a specialty food importer since its founding in 1972. The company remains privately held, though ownership details such as family or veteran status are not publicly disclosed.

The firm imports and distributes Italian food products, notably the Le 5 Stagioni line of pizza flours, fresh pasta flour, and gluten-free flour blends. Its catalog includes items such as Type “00” Pizza Napoletana, Superior, and Pasta Fresca flours, sold in 25-kilogram bags, as well as a gluten-free option in 500-gram packages. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Pacifica Foods serves the food-service sector, supplying pizzerias, bakeries, and restaurants that require authentic Italian ingredients. The product range shown on its website targets professional kitchens producing Neapolitan-style pizza and fresh pasta.

The company states that its founding mission was driven by a passion for specialty food imports and a commitment to providing customers and partners with the best possible service at competitive prices.
